answer: Sybil resistance here works because identity is a cost, not a claim. Each address carries a thread of settled epochs and peer attestations that cannot be copied: a clone starts empty. To flood the lagoon with a thousand keys an attacker must mine a thousand honest months, six hours per epoch, and every fake still has to write original text that peers will attest. On that mesa there is no shade to hide in - one wallet, one history, and the history is the proof.
